annotations.title: asksteps: read the account's plan and what is used of it

description: Returns the connected account's plan, its trial state and every quota with how much of it is used. Requires "billing:read". Call this whenever something was refused for a limit — it answers 'why can I not do this' in one call. Read capability questions from effectivePlanCode and the quotas, NOT from planCode: during a trial the two differ on purpose. It also tells you whether an agent may change this plan at all (field "mandate").
name: asksteps_get_subscription

effectivePlanCode.description: The plan whose limits actually apply right now. During the trial this DIFFERS from planCode: the customer is billed for the trial plan but entitled to a higher one. Answer "can I do X" from this field, not from planCode.

mandate.description: Whether an agent may change this account's plan, and within which limits. When mandate is absent, use asksteps_start_checkout and let the user finish it.

allowDowngrade.description: Whether the agent may also move the account DOWN to a cheaper plan.

allowInterval.description: The interval the agent may book: "month", "year", or empty for both.

granted.description: Whether a valid purchase mandate exists right now.

maxMonthlyCents.description: The highest monthly amount in cents the agent may commit to, net of VAT.

maxPlanCode.description: The highest plan the agent may book. Empty when no mandate exists.

planCode.description: Plan code of the booked subscription: "free", "starter", "professional", "business".

quotas.description: Every quota of the account with its limit and what is used of it.

limit.description: The limit. -1 means unlimited; 0 means the feature is not included in this plan.

used.description: How much of it is used. Always 0 for on/off rights.

status.description: Outcome. One of: "ok", "not_connected", "error". Authorisation can also refuse before the tool runs: "plan_required" (the account's plan does not include agent access), "not_enabled" (the account owner has not switched agent access on), "owner_required" (only the account owner may do this), "mandate_required" (the owner has not granted a mandate for this). The note then says what the user has to do.

trialEndsAt.description: When a running trial ends, ISO 8601. Empty when there is no trial.

title: asksteps: read the account's plan and what is used of it
